conventions: Where the ASV's English follows the 1 Kings 12 parallel against the WLC text of this chapter and the packet records no variant unit — 10.14 'My father' before 'made your yoke heavy' where WLC writes the 1cs אכביד, and 10.16 'when all Israel saw' where WLC writes no ראה — the surplus English is added with a rule-53 note naming the Kings reading, and the token the projection does carry (אכביד → 'made heavy') is aligned as printed. No token is marked unrepresented to answer for it and no textual decision is taken in the alignment.

The gapped second colon of 'my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions' (10.11, 10.14) realizes the one written יסר twice: the italic 'will chastise' joins the verb's discontinuous unit and the italic 'you' joins the object suffix's under rules 34 and 25, neither being added; the waw of ואני takes 'but' and the pronoun its own 'I'.
report: Read all 40 candidate groups against the verses. No construction is analysed two ways with nothing in the source to license the difference: the suffix, waw, article, preposition and verb variation is the ASV rendering one word differently in context (his/him/their; And/but/So/then/that; to/unto; the present/absent), and each unit takes what is written for it.

Recurring constructions are consistent across the chapter: 'king Rehoboam/king Solomon' leaves the article on מלך unrepresented (10.2, 6, 13, 18); 'old men'/'young men' head on old/young with men as the supplied generic (10.6, 8, 10, 13, 14); 'make ... lighter' heads on the complement in all three verses, the thou going to the verb in 10.4 and to the explicit אתה in 10.10; 'Come again' keeps again with שוב in 10.5 and 10.12; the gapped 'will chastise you' is the repeated realization of יסר and its suffix in both 10.11 and 10.14; demonstrative phrases leave both articles unrepresented (10.6, 7, 9, 19); attributive articles rendered by a relative take it (10.8, 10.17).

The two places where the ASV follows the 1 Kings 12 parallel against WLC Chronicles (10.14 'My father' for אכביד, 10.16 'when ... saw' with no ראה) are handled alike: no variant unit is recorded, so the English is added with a rule-53 note and the token the projection carries is aligned as printed.

BSB disagreements are all convention differences: the 16 articles are 'king X' titles, agreement articles beside a demonstrative or ordinal, and the article on אלהים; the 15 prepositions are the ל of לאמר, the partitive מן of 'make lighter', dative/resultative ל recast under rule 40, and the temporal ב of 'the third day'; the 3 object markers are rule 16; the 5 waws are two apodosis waws (10.16, 10.17), an asyndetic recasting (10.11), a reordering (10.5) and 'and he died' recast as 'to death' (10.18). None is an error.

Two hedged units are noted rather than patched: 10.5 gives 'after' to עוד ('yet three days' → 'after three days'), where rule 33 would instead put it on the numeral phrase and leave עוד unrepresented; 10.6 fuses היות ... חי → 'lived' across the subject suffix under rules 30/35, the competing reading leaving היות unrepresented. Both notes already name the alternative.
The large-source unit at 10.7 (כל־הימים → 'for ever') matches the seven corpus units rule 30 cites. Nothing here generalises beyond the contract; no promotions or amendments.
